subject.title: feat(ios): show OpenClaw logo in notch

question: Should OpenClaw ship this screenshot-only iOS notch logo using TopNotch's private UIScreen KVC lookup and the newly tagged forked dependency?
rationale: The patch is narrow and the screenshots prove the visual behavior, but App Store acceptance, future iOS compatibility, and dependency provenance are release-owner choices rather than an automation-safe correctness verdict.

options.title: Approve after compliance and archive proof
options.body: Require the TopNotch license resource, conflict resolution, current merge-result iOS archive proof, and explicit iOS/release-owner approval before merge.

options.title: Switch to public-API branding
options.body: Ask for a branding approach that avoids private UIScreen introspection if owners do not want the App Store and future-iOS risk.

options.title: Defer the notch overlay
options.body: Pause or close the PR if screenshot-only notch branding is not worth the new dependency and release-policy cost.

recommendation.title: Approve after compliance and archive proof
recommendation.body: Require the TopNotch license resource, conflict resolution, current merge-result iOS archive proof, and explicit iOS/release-owner approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS release and screenshot-flow work makes this the best available routing candidate for the merge-risk decision, with ngutman as the iOS app-area counterpart.
